_meta.description: Battle Frontier candidate build pool with filtered Gen9 Smogon/Showdown sets, generated Missingmons sets, and normalized Pokemon Champions sets.

champions_integration.policy: Champions Megas are stored as base species with their Mega Stone item and source_form preserving the Champions form name. Champions builds are late-stage main builds unless the species was already boss.
champions_integration.mega_metadata_backfill_note: Builds carrying a project Mega Stone item_const are marked is_mega_set=true and receive source_form when missing.
champions_integration.illegal_mega_item_form_builds_removed_no: Removed form/item Mega mismatches discovered during item_const Mega metadata backfill.

_meta.sp_to_ev_method: round(stat_points / 32 * 252) to nearest multiple of 4, clamp each stat at 252, reduce total to 508
_meta.normalization_policy: Every build has moves/move_consts, item/item_const, ability/ability_const, nature/nature_const, evs, ivs, frontier_pool, frontier_stage, and battle_style. Tera, Z-Move, Dynamax, and placeholder Nothing entries are excluded.
